ROW.COLUMN: Frequent changes to the address for an account are unusual. Such changes to contact and statement notification information, such as mailing address, could indicate fraudulent activity such as an account takeover scheme. This scenario identifies customer accounts with multiple address changes within a client configurable time period.
Dataset To Retreive the Customer Accounts with no of multiple mailing address changes greater than client specified Min # Address Change parameter during the lookback period

--Primary Rule Account with Multiple Address Changes select A.ACCT_INTRL_ID, A.ACCT_SEQ_ID, -- TO CALCULATE NO OF MAILING ADDRESS CHANGES DURING THE LOOKBACK PERIOD count(distinct C.CHG_DT) as ADDR_CHG_CT, -- SUITABILITY SURVEILLANCE LEVEL NUMBER OF THE ACCOUNT max(A.STBLTY_SURVL_LEVEL_NB) SSL, -- EARLIEST DATE OF ADDRESS CHANGE IN THIS ALERT. min(C.CHG_DT) EARLIEST_DT, -- LAST DATE OF ADDRESS CHANGE IN THIS ALERT. max(C.CHG_DT) LATEST_DT, -- GEOGRAPHICAL RISK LEVEL OF THE NEW ADDRESS COUNTRY IN THE ALERT. max(G.GEO_EFCTV_RISK_NB) ACCT_GEO_RISK_NB from --TO INCLUDE MAILING ADDRESS CHANGES FOR HISTORICAL ACCOUNT IDENTIFIERS @BUSINESS@.ACCT_ID_CHG_HIST AICH right outer join @BUSINESS@.CHG_LOG C on C.KEY1_TX = AICH.PREV_ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT A on A.ACCT_INTRL_ID = coalesce(AICH.CURR_ACCT_INTRL_ID,C.KEY1_TX) inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_ADDR AA ON (AA.ACCT_INTRL_ID = A.ACCT_INTRL_ID and TO_CHAR(AA.ADDR_SEQ_NB)= C.KEY2_TX and AA.ADDR_USAGE_CD = C.KEY3_TX) -- GEOGRAPHICAL RISK LEVEL OF THE NEW ADDRESS COUNTRY IN THE ALERT. inner join @BUSINESS@.Geography G on G.GEO_CNTRY_CD = AA.ADDR_CNTRY_CD where -- TO RETREIVE THE ACCOUNTS WITH ACCOUNT PURPOSE CODE -MAILING (@All_Add_Pur_Fl = 'Y' or AA.ADDR_USAGE_CD = (@Incld_Add_Pur_Lst)) -- TO INCLUDE CHANGE RECORDS FOR ACCOUNT ADDRESS TABLE and C.TBL_NM = 'ACCT_ADDR' -- TO INCLUDE MAILING ADDRESSES FOR CUSTOMER ACCOUNTS ONLY and coalesce(A.EMP_ACCT_FL,'N') = 'N' -- TO INCLUDE THE CHANGE RECORDS WITHIN LOOKBACK PERIOD and C.CHG_DT <= (select KC.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC where KC.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and KC.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1') and C.CHG_DT > (select ADD_MONTHS(KC.CLNDR_DT, -@Lookback_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC where KC.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and KC.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1') --TO INCLUDE THE CLIENT SPECIFIED LIST OF JURISDICTION CODES and (@All_Jurisdictions = 'Y' or A.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incld_Jurisdiction_Cd)) --TO INCLUDE ORACLE BUSINESS ACCT TYPES and A.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Oracle_Bus_Acct_Typ_Lst) --To include Mantas Acct Holder Types and A.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD in (@Incld_Acct_Hold_Typ_Lst) -- Included Surveillance Tier Codes and coalesce(to_char(A.STBLTY_SURVL_LEVEL_NB), 'NULL') in (@Incld_Surv_Tier_Lst) --EXCLUDE ACCOUNTS USING USAGE LIST ACCOUNT IDENTIFIERS and A.ACCT_INTRL_ID not in (select BGUL.NTITY_INTRL_ID from @BUSINESS@.GEN_USAGE_LIST BGUL where BGUL.LIST_TYPE_CD in (@Usg_Acct_Ident_Lst) and (BGUL.XPRTN_DT is null or BGUL.XPRTN_DT > (select KC.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC where KC.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and KC.BUS_DAY_AGE = 0) )) group by A.ACCT_INTRL_ID, A.ACCT_SEQ_ID having -- TO CHECK WHETHER NO OF ADDRESS CHANGES IS GREATER THAN CLIENT SPECIFIED VALUE count(distinct C.CHG_DT) >= @Min_Addr_Changes -- TO CHECK MAILING ADDRESS HAS BEEN CHANGED ATLEAST ONCE WITHIN THE SPECIFIED FREQUENCY PERIOD and max(C.CHG_DT) <= (select KC.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC where KC.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and KC.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1') and max(C.CHG_DT) > (select ADD_MONTHS(KC.CLNDR_DT, -@Frequency_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC where KC.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and KC.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1')
Dataset To retreive Account Address records for Building Block

--Account Address Building Block select A.ACCT_INTRL_ID ACCT_INTRL_ID, AA.ACCT_ADDR_SEQ_ID from --TO INCLUDE MAILING ADDRESS CHANGES FOR HISTORICAL ACCOUNT IDENTIFIERS @BUSINESS@.ACCT_ID_CHG_HIST AICH right outer join @BUSINESS@.CHG_LOG C on C.KEY1_TX = AICH.PREV_ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT A on A.ACCT_INTRL_ID = COALESCE(AICH.CURR_ACCT_INTRL_ID,C.KEY1_TX) inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_ADDR AA on (AA.ACCT_INTRL_ID = A.ACCT_INTRL_ID and TO_CHAR(AA.ADDR_SEQ_NB)= C.KEY2_TX and AA.ADDR_USAGE_CD = C.KEY3_TX) where -- TO RETREIVE THE ACCOUNTS WITH ACCOUNT PURPOSE CODE -MAILING (@All_Add_Pur_Fl = 'Y' or AA.ADDR_USAGE_CD = (@Incld_Add_Pur_Lst)) -- TO INCLUDE CHANGE RECORDS FOR ACCOUNT ADDRESS TABLE and C.TBL_NM = 'ACCT_ADDR' -- TO INCLUDE THE CHANGE RECORDS WITHIN LOOKBACK PERIOD and C.CHG_DT <= (select KC.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC where KC.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and KC.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1') and C.CHG_DT > (select ADD_MONTHS(KC.CLNDR_DT, -@Lookback_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC where KC.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and KC.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1')
Dataset To Retreive Change log records for Building Block

--Account Change Log Summary Building Block select Distinct A.ACCT_INTRL_ID as ACCT_INTRL_ID, ACL.ACCT_CHG_LOG_SMRY_SEQ_ID from --TO INCLUDE MAILING ADDRESS CHANGES FOR HISTORICAL ACCOUNT IDENTIFIERS @BUSINESS@.ACCT_ID_CHG_HIST AICH right outer join @BUSINESS@.CHG_LOG C on C.KEY1_TX = AICH.PREV_ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT A on A.ACCT_INTRL_ID = coalesce(AICH.CURR_ACCT_INTRL_ID,C.KEY1_TX) inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_ADDR AA ON (AA.ACCT_INTRL_ID = A.ACCT_INTRL_ID and TO_CHAR(AA.ADDR_SEQ_NB)= C.KEY2_TX and AA.ADDR_USAGE_CD = C.KEY3_TX) -- GEOGRAPHICAL RISK LEVEL OF THE NEW ADDRESS COUNTRY IN THE ALERT. inner join @BUSINESS@.Geography G on G.GEO_CNTRY_CD = AA.ADDR_CNTRY_CD inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_CHG_LOG_SMRY ACL on ACL.ACCT_INTRL_ID = C.KEY1_TX and C.CHG_DT = ACL.CHG_DT where -- TO RETREIVE THE ACCOUNTS WITH ACCOUNT PURPOSE CODE -MAILING (@All_Add_Pur_Fl = 'Y' or AA.ADDR_USAGE_CD = (@Incld_Add_Pur_Lst)) -- TO INCLUDE CHANGE RECORDS FOR ACCOUNT ADDRESS TABLE and C.TBL_NM = 'ACCT_ADDR' -- TO INCLUDE THE CHANGE RECORDS WITHIN LOOKBACK PERIOD and C.CHG_DT <= (select KC.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC where KC.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and KC.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1') and C.CHG_DT > (select ADD_MONTHS(KC.CLNDR_DT, -@Lookback_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC where KC.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and KC.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1')

Parameter that allows the coverage of all address purpose codes without enumerating them in the Included Address Purpose Codes threshold. Y: Covers all address purpose codes regardless of the Included Address Purpose Code threshold value. N: Covers only those address purpose codes that are listed in the Included Address Purpose Codes threshold.

Parameter that allows the coverage of all jurisdictions without enumerating them in the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold. Y: Covers all jurisdiction codes regardless of the Included Jurisdiction Code threshold value. N: Covers only those jurisdictions that are listed in the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold.
Number of months specified for the frequency period.
Codes that identify the account holder types used by the scenario threshold set. Allowable values are defined in DIS.
Codes that identify the address purpose codes used by the scenario threshold set. Allowable values are defined in DIS.
The list of jurisdiction codes that the scenario covers. The Oracle client defines the allowable values.
List Surveillance Tiers covered by the threshold set. Scale ranges from 1 (strictest) to 6 (least stringent).
Number of months prior to the current month specified for the lookback period.
Minimum number of days with customer account address change required to generate an alert.
Codes that identify the business purpose or usage of this account in this scenarios.
Identifier of the General Usage List which contains the Accounts to be excluded from behavior detection.
